_comment: Golden reference for the ORIGINAL Shadow Fight 2 damage formula.
Recovered from Model::getTotalDamage @ game+0x4527B4 by decompiling the
relocated runtime dump in Ghidra (image base 0x8F057000).
The function was found via the sole cross-reference to its assert string
'Model::getTotalDamage - wtf so strong' at 0x8F79A2A0 -- a developer
sanity warning that fires when damage escapes [0, 100000].

power_base._how: mov r0, #0x40000000 at every powf call site
power_base._note: 2.0 is the BASE of the power, not a trailing x2 multiplier. reSF2 had it as a separate '* 2.0f' term, which double-counts once the curve is correct.

doubling_range._how: global settings struct +0x18, read as 10.0f; matches <DamageDoublingRange Value="10"/> in internalSettings.xml
doubling_range._semantics: factor = 2 ^ (attribute_delta / 10), so every 10 points of attribute advantage DOUBLES the damage
doubling_range._resistance_note: <ResistanceDoublingRange Value="500"/> -- same curve shape, used for enchantment resistance

sanity_check._note: The range check only logs; the out-of-range value is returned unchanged. A clamping implementation would diverge on very strong builds.

evaluation_order: dmg  = base * f2 * f1 * f3 * add
_order_note: float multiplication is not associative; the emitted order is base * f2 * f1 * f3 * add (f2 before f1)

disabled_term_value._how: moveq r4, #0x3f800000 in both factor helpers
disabled_term_value._note: A disabled attribute term returns 1.0 (multiplicatively neutral), never 0 and never skipped

attacker_defender_split._note: f1 receives the ATTACKER (self, is_ranged); f2 receives the DEFENDER (enemy, weapon). This asymmetry is the DamageAttribute / DefenseAttribute split printed by the game's built-in tracer.

expected_values._comment: Independently computed from the recovered formula; used as regression anchors.

linear_vs_exponential._note: reSF2 used 1 + factor*attr. The two forms agree ONLY at attr == 0, which is the value reSF2 hardcoded -- so the bug was invisible.

assert_trigger._note: why the developers added the warning: the curve is unbounded

align_target_attributes._note: the attribute baseline the engine still lacks; needed to feed this formula
